rationale: David brings deep expertise in shipping autonomous systems to production—from drones at Skycatch to tractors at Agtonomy—and is now building real-time infrastructure at LiveKit specifically for robotics. Sina is building computer vision and robotics systems for precision e-waste recycling at Tuurny and is actively expanding his engineering team. David's conviction that production robotics requires purpose-built real-time observability infrastructure, combined with his hands-on experience scaling robotics software teams, maps directly onto Sina's need to scale autonomous systems for high-precision component recovery.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Sina Ghashghaei—David spent a decade shipping autonomous systems to production (drones, tractors) and now builds real-time infrastructure for robotics at LiveKit; Sina is scaling computer vision and robotics for precision e-waste recycling at Tuurny and raising to expand his engineering team.
